_comment: Generated by python -m walkers.assembly. Lengths in mm, masses in g. Frame: x forward, y left, z up, origin on the centre axle between the panels.
status: Analysed only. Nothing here has been printed, assembled or powered.

gear_mesh.stock_gear: module 1, 16 teeth, 16 mm pitch diameter, 7.8 mm wide
gear_mesh.verdict: Module 1, 16 teeth: the same pitch as a Technic 16-tooth gear, and the 16 mm axle spacing is the standard centre distance. The printed tooth is thinned for backlash. A stock gear is 7.8 mm wide against the printed 5 mm.

ev3-pixy2.title: EV3 brick, two large motors, Pixy2
placements: Head fixed: pinned through its two holes 32 mm apart to the shelf holes at x = 84, y = +/-16. The optional pan motor under the shelf is not modelled.
Gears inside each panel with 1 mm to the panel face, all three in one plane.
Cranks 8 mm outboard of the panel, legs outside the cranks with their inner faces 75 mm from the centreline: 1.2 mm between crank and leg.
The idler axle is retained by one full bush outboard of the panel; the cranks sweep past its end.

Motors between the panels, output hub on the rear gear axle (x = -16), body pointing backward, centred 30 mm from the centreline. The README says only: one motor per side on the rear gear axle, held by stock beams.
Brick flat on the deck, long side fore and aft between the two rows of strap slots, centred at x = 0. The README says only: strapped across the deck through the four slots.
Pan-tilt kit on the head's top platform with the Pixy2 on its tilt bracket; kit size and mass are assumed.

lowest fixed part above the floor.note: floor at its highest, both feet level

pi-zero-2w-51515.title: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W, Build HAT, two 51515 motors
placements: Head fixed: pinned through its two holes 32 mm apart to the shelf holes at x = 84, y = +/-16. The optional pan motor under the shelf is not modelled.
Gears inside each panel with 1 mm to the panel face, all three in one plane.
Cranks 8 mm outboard of the panel, legs outside the cranks with their inner faces 75 mm from the centreline: 1.2 mm between crank and leg.
The idler axle is retained by one full bush outboard of the panel; the cranks sweep past its end.

Motors between the panels, output hub on the rear gear axle (x = -16), body pointing backward, centred 31 mm from the centreline. The README says only: one motor per side on the rear gear axle, held by stock beams.
Pi Zero 2 W on the four bosses, header along the left edge, Build HAT on 9 mm spacers above it overhanging 26.5 mm to the right. Which way round the Pi sits is not stated in the README.
Camera Module 2 on the forward side of the head's face plate.
No battery: the Build HAT's supported supply is a mains adapter, so the robot is tethered. The cable is not modelled.

hub-51515.title: 51515 hub, two medium angular motors
placements: Head fixed: pinned through its two holes 32 mm apart to the shelf holes at x = 84, y = +/-16. The optional pan motor under the shelf is not modelled.
Gears inside each panel with 1 mm to the panel face, all three in one plane.
Cranks 8 mm outboard of the panel, legs outside the cranks with their inner faces 75 mm from the centreline: 1.2 mm between crank and leg.
The idler axle is retained by one full bush outboard of the panel; the cranks sweep past its end.

Motors between the panels, output hub on the rear gear axle (x = -16), body pointing backward, centred 31 mm from the centreline. The README says only: one motor per side on the rear gear axle, held by stock beams.
Hub flat on the deck, long side fore and aft, between the two end stops and under two straps, centred at x = 0. Its pin holes are not published, so it is strapped.
No camera: the Pixy2 cannot plug into this hub's ports. The head is the plate with a row of seven pin holes for a self-contained camera or a LEGO sensor.

findings.text: ev3-pixy2: no part overlaps another at rest or at any of 72 crank phases, motors, controller and camera included.
ev3-pixy2: 811.5 g. The centre of mass stays over the stance foot at every phase with at least 10.2 mm to spare; a tilt of 4.2 degrees uses that up.
ev3-pixy2: with the motors pointing forward the margin falls to 1.8 mm. Point them backward.
pi-zero-2w-51515: no part overlaps another at rest or at any of 72 crank phases, motors, controller and camera included.
pi-zero-2w-51515: 377.9 g. The centre of mass stays over the stance foot at every phase with at least 10.2 mm to spare; a tilt of 5.8 degrees uses that up.
hub-51515: no part overlaps another at rest or at any of 72 crank phases, motors, controller and camera included.
hub-51515: 478.4 g. The centre of mass stays over the stance foot at every phase with at least 10.0 mm to spare; a tilt of 5.1 degrees uses that up.
Gears: 16 teeth, module 1, on the standard 16 mm centres; 0.387 mm backlash per mesh, 5.54 degrees of play between the two cranks of a side.
